snippet.title: Movierooms Cinema Tycoon | Early Access Launch Date Trailer (coming March 17)
snippet.description:
Build your Cinema. Make history with Movierooms:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2473820/Movierooms__Cinema_Management/

Movierooms (Alpha version) is a cinema-theater tycoon indiegame game developed by Mad Pumpkins GameStudio, officially launches on Steam on March 17th, 2026. Players will build and customize their own cinema, manage staff and screenings and explore historical missions while helping shape the game through community feedback.
